key_insight: CIDERS frames cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a personalized bilevel optimization problem, aligning global cloud knowledge transfer with edge-specific adaptation through consensus-variate correction.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical optimization framework for deploying LLMs on resource-constrained edge systems while preserving both shared knowledge and task/domain personalization.
method: Decompose the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger
Use a bilevel objective: edge personalization on the upper level, cloud knowledge transfer on the lower level
Inject global trajectory information into local updates via consensus-variate correction
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong gains over baselines on edge deployment tasks, including 3.1x improvement in mathematical reasoning, 1.7x in code generation, and a 10% relative gain on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds optimization and coordination complexity, so stability and communication overhead may be important concerns in real edge deployments.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
